context: Tests whether the agent applies the three-gate ADR test correctly, creates CODEBASE.md in the correct format with contexts and relationships, and cross-references user claims against the actual code to surface contradictions.

checklist.name: ADR three-gate test applied
checklist.description: adr-decisions.md evaluates decisions against all three criteria: hard-to-reverse, surprising-without-context, and result-of-a-real-trade-off

checklist.name: ADR delegation noted
checklist.description: adr-decisions.md states that any qualifying decision would be delegated to the create-adr skill, NOT created directly

checklist.name: Redis decision evaluated
checklist.description: adr-decisions.md evaluates the Redis Streams choice as an ADR candidate (it involves genuine alternatives and lock-in — should qualify)

checklist.name: CODEBASE.md created
checklist.description: docs/context/CODEBASE.md exists and was created as an output of the session

checklist.name: Contexts section present
checklist.description: CODEBASE.md contains a ## Contexts section listing each bounded context with its directory path and a one-line purpose

checklist.name: Relationships section present
checklist.description: CODEBASE.md contains a ## Relationships section showing direction and mechanism (events, shared types, or API calls) between contexts

checklist.name: Code contradiction surfaced
checklist.description: session-log.md shows the agent pointing out that the current code is synchronous (NotificationService is called directly from order flow) while the plan claims the system is already event-driven — or similar code-vs-plan contradiction

checklist.name: One question per turn
checklist.description: Each turn in session-log.md contains exactly one question — no multi-question batching

checklist.name: Recommendation stated first
checklist.description: Each question in the session log includes the agent's own recommended answer before the user's response

checklist.name: Session covers all open questions
checklist.description: session-log.md addresses all three open questions from the plan: retry logic ownership, notification preferences ownership, and SMS/push context split
